# Reinforcement Learning for Execution {#plan-ch17}

::: {.planned-chapter}
Planned
:::

Examines when execution should be treated as a learned sequential policy and why offline data make that problem difficult.

**Subtopics.** MDPs and partially observed MDPs; state, action, transition, and reward design; inventory and deadline constraints; simulator construction; simulator bias; behavior policies; offline reinforcement learning; off-policy evaluation; distribution shift; conservative policy improvement; safe exploration; policy guardrails; comparison with model-predictive control.
